properties.state: {"description":"With `--only-if-present`, a session opened where no design has been started is served the LATENT surface: the handshake says reflow2 is installed and available and that this directory has no design, exactly one tool is served (`reflow2_start_design`), and NOTHING is created — no store, no state, no files. The check is a filesystem test on the graph's own directory, because opening is the thing that would create. Distinct from the degraded surface on purpose: degraded means a graph exists and could not be opened, which is an outage; latent means nobody ever made one, which is ordinary. The loop-nudge hook is gated by the same test, so a machine-wide hook registration is silent everywhere reflow2 is not being used.","is_entry_point":false,"is_exit_point":false,"name":"A directory with no design costs nothing","provenance":"authored","status":"realized","tier":"operational"}
